title: Coherent ring-family descent from locally equal section ideals
statement: Let $(C,J,O)$ be a small ringed site, let $K,\epsilon,m$ be a specified strictly functorial augmented ring-complex family [def-weil-pbc-ring-complex-cech-data], and let $U:A\to C$ be any small family with finite section lists $f_i$ over $U_i$. Assume that for every span $W\to U_i,W\to U_j$, their extended section ideals are equal on a covering sieve of $W$. The explicit sheafified slice models [def-weil-pbc-functorial-ring-complex-sheaf], with their maps to the restriction of $O[0]$ [def-weil-pbc-ringed-derived-restriction], admit strict augmented descent data [def-weil-pbc-augmented-module-complex-glue-data]. No covering assumption on $U$, finite-type ideal module, derived category or Čech comparison is assumed.

proof.text: On a common test span restrict both presheaf complexes to its slice. The hypothesis on further spans gives a covering equality locus. Apply the canonical augmented comparison for locally equal ideals and identify the resulting sheafifications with the restrictions of the original models.

The unit-section formulas uniquely specify the comparison, by the covering-locus hom-ext theorem. Further restriction preserves the formula, proving naturality. On three lists, refine to the intersection of equality loci; transitivity of equality transport proves the cocycle by the same hom-ext theorem. The chain equation comes from the chain comparisons. Test augmentation on presheaf-unit sections: its equality is the ring-family augmentation equation under ideal transport. The adjunction and hom-ext theorem prove it globally. Evaluation at the terminal test object gives the required linear transitions.

theorem exists_ringFamily_idealDescentData
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (O : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
    (K : RingComplexFamily.{u}) (ε : RingComplexAugmentations K)
    (m : RingComplexMaps K) (hm : RingComplexFunctorial K ε m)
    {A : Type u} (U : A → C) (r : A → ℕ)
    (f : ∀ i : A, Fin (r i) → O.obj.obj (op (U i)))
    (heq : ∀ (i j : A) (W : C) (a : W ⟶ U i) (b : W ⟶ U j),
      ∃ S ∈ J W, ∀ (V : C) (k : V ⟶ W), S k →
        Ideal.span (Set.range (fun t ↦ O.obj.map (k ≫ a).op (f i t))) =
          Ideal.span (Set.range (fun t ↦ O.obj.map (k ≫ b).op (f j t)))) :
    Nonempty (SheafOfModules.AugmentedComplexGlueData
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O) U (ringedSiteRingComplex O)
      (fun i ↦ (ringFamilySheafModel (O.over (U i)) K ε m hm (r i)
        (fun t ↦ ringedSliceSection O (U i) (f i t))).1)
      (fun i ↦ (ringFamilySheafModel (O.over (U i)) K ε m hm (r i)
        (fun t ↦ ringedSliceSection O (U i) (f i t))).2 ≫
          (ringedRestrictionRingComplexIso O (U i)).inv))
